rites.name: Xaithis
rites.text: Xaithis is a concept held in the Courts of Thurdock, a notion of a binding word that the trial-judges use to close oaths during the Holy Age. It lives mostly in the ritual of the councils, where a spoken vow is sealed and cannot be taken back.

rites.name: Koggurn
rites.text: Koggurn is a concept of the Thurdock Weave, a lattice of threads that the makers plant during the Seeding to hold quiet powers in sleep. It does not act on its own but records how the threads are laid and where they are knotted.

rites.name: Brordeldon
rites.text: Brordeldon is a concept of the Thurdock Walled Age, a notion of a holding wall and the orders that kept it standing through centuries of landfall. During the Age of Sundering, the idea was used to name the first crossings that broke old bonds between settlements.
